verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's own docs say its Unified Payments API connects to all payment methods through a single integration. Its payment-methods page offers local payment methods and digital wallets alongside cards, and Flow accepts payments through one integration. However, this is marketing-level evidence that never names the specific methods in the story; Google Pay appears only in the separate agentic-commerce context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Apple Pay, Google Pay in standard checkout, bank redirects and BNPL support; per-method integration guides; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Get instant access to all the local payment methods, digital wallets, and global card schemes you need for smarter regional strategies and happier customers.
Unified Payments API: Connect to all payment methods through a single API integration.
Accept payments using customizable components – all through one simple integration.
